SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5836
Date 15 / 5 / 34

May 15, 1934.
Afternoon Translation

Sin Wan Pao and other local papers:-

GENERAL HWANG FU NGHAI

General Hwang Fu Nghai, Chairman of the Peiping Political Affairs Re-adjustment Committee, is still in Shanghai. He has not yet returned to the North to resume office, and is waiting for the result of the discussion regarding postal communication in Manchukuo at the Sino-Japanese Ad Hoc Committee meeting to be held under the auspices of the League of Nations.

General Hwang granted an interview to local banking circles and various members of the Political Re-adjustment Committee in Shanghai yesterday morning. In the afternoon he paid a visit to Mayor Wu Te Chen. At 4.45 p.m. yesterday, he held a conference with local financial magnates.

General Chiang Kai Shek sent his Ford aeroplane to Nanking for General Hwang Fu Nghai in the afternoon of May 14. It is learnt that General Hwang Fu Nghai will proceed to Kiangsi by aeroplane to interview General Chiang Kai Shek.

Postal Communication in Manchukuo

Commenting on the Manchukuo postal communication question, Sin Wan Pao remarks that the delay in the arrival of foreign mail matters from Shanghai to Europe is due to the fact that the Siberian railway route is not in use owing to the occupation of Manchuria by Japan. China sympathises with the difficulty and inconvenience suffered by foreign residents in Shanghai. The foreign clients should ask their Governments to lodge protest with the Japanese Government. China is not responsible for the delay in the arrival of the mails.

1934年5月15日。
下午译文

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

黄郛将军

北平政务整理委员会委员长黄郛将军目前仍在上海。他尚未返回北方复职，正在等待即将在国联主持下召开的中日特别委员会会议上关于“满洲国”邮政通信问题的讨论结果。

昨日上午，黄将军接见了上海本地银行界人士及政务整理委员会的各位委员。下午，他拜访了市长吴铁城。昨日下午4时45分，他与本地金融巨头举行了会议。

5月14日下午，蒋介石将军派遣其福特飞机前往南京接黄郛将军。据悉，黄郛将军将乘飞机前往江西会见蒋介石将军。

“满洲国”的邮政通信

就“满洲国”邮政通信问题，《新闻报》评论称，上海寄往欧洲的国外邮件延误，是因为日本占领满洲导致西伯利亚铁路路线无法使用。中国对上海外侨所遭受的困难和不便表示同情。外国客户应要求其政府向日本政府提出抗议。邮件延误的责任不在中国。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5836
Date 13 / 5 / 34

May 13, 1934. Morning Translation.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

ARRIVAL OF HUANG FU.

General Huang Fu, Chairman of the Peiping Political Affairs Re-organization Committee, arrived in Shanghai at 3.30 p.m. yesterday from Hangchow. He immediately proceeded to his private residence on Route Ghisi, French Concession.
It is learned that General Huang will sojourn here for two or three days before proceeding to Nanking to call on Mr. Wang Ching Wei, concurrently Minister of Foreign Affairs.
The report that General Huang Fu will go to the North to assume office after meeting Mr. Ariyoshi, the Japanese Minister to China, in Shanghai is untrue. General Huang will receive newspapermen this afternoon.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

BAN ON PRIVATE RADIO STATIONS.

The Ministry of Communications recently received a confidential report to the effect that the Philips China Company and the Mei Hwa Company (美華公司) in Shanghai have stealthily established radio stations without permits. As this procedure violates the Regulations of the Ministry governing the installation of radio stations, the Ministry has requested the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to instruct the Shanghai City Government to suppress these radio stations.
It is understood that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has instructed the Shanghai City Government to conduct an investigation and to order the Philips China Company and the Mei Hwa Company to close their radio stations.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

MAY 14 INCIDENT : PRECAUTIONARY MEASURES TO BE ADOPTED.

Tomorrow (May 14) is the anniversary of the day when the Japanese of the Shanghai Naigai Wata Kaisha Cotton Mill shot a worker named Koo Tseng Hung (顧正紅). The May 30 Tragedy was the sequel to this incident.
According to a report secured by the Bureau of Public Safety, adherents of the Communist Party will form groups and hold a procession on that day. Precautionary measures will be adopted in Chinese controlled territory on May 14.
The Settlement Police will likewise adopt precautions in the factory zones at Yangtzepoo and Zau Ka Doo (曹家渡).

1934年5月13日。上午译文。

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

黄郛抵沪。

北平政务整理委员会委员长黄郛将军于昨日下午3时30分从杭州抵达上海。他随即前往法租界贾西爱路（Route Ghisi）的私宅。
据悉，黄将军将在沪逗留两三天，随后前往南京拜会兼任外交部长的汪精卫先生。
有关黄郛将军在上海会见日本驻华公使有吉明后即将北上就职的报道不实。黄将军将于今天下午接见新闻记者。

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

禁止私人广播电台。

交通部近日收到一份密报，称上海的飞利浦中国公司（Philips China Company）和美华公司（Mei Hwa Company）未经许可擅自设立广播电台。由于此举违反了交通部关于安装广播电台的规定，交通部已请求外交部指示上海市政府取缔这些广播电台。
据悉，外交部已指示上海市政府进行调查，并命令飞利浦中国公司和美华公司关闭其广播电台。

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

五月十四日事件：将采取预防措施。

明日（5月14日）是上海内外棉株式会社的日本职员枪杀一名名叫顾正红的工人的周年纪念日。“五卅惨案”即是此事件的后续。
根据公安局获得的一份报告，共产党追随者将在当天结队举行游行。5月14日，在华界地区将采取预防措施。
租界警方亦将在杨树浦和曹家渡的工厂区采取预防措施。

page_data.en:
Extract from Intelligence Report. 21.4.34.

Anonymous letters threatening the life of Gen. Huang Fu
On April 20 anonymous letters in Chinese and addressed
to Chinese constables were received by post at various
Police Stations in the Settlement. The missives, which
contain denunciations of the Kuomintang policy vis-a-vis
Japan and North China, exhort the recipients to withhold
protection from General Hwang Fu, Chairman of the Peiping
Political Council who is accused of having arrived in
Shanghai with a view to contracting with the Japanese
Minister a secret agreement whereby all the provinces
in North China will be ceded to Japan. It is further
intimated that the writers plan the assassination of
Huang. The letters purport to emanate from various
organs all of which are unknown and considered
mythical.

威胁黄郛将军生命的匿名信
4月20日，租界内各警察局通过邮递收到了用中文书写并寄给华捕的匿名信。这些信件谴责国民党对日本和华北的政策，敦促收件人不要保护北平政务委员会主席黄郛将军，指控他抵达上海是为了与日本公使签订一项秘密协议，将华北各省割让给日本。信中进一步暗示，写信人计划刺杀黄郛。信件声称来自各个机构，但这些机构均不为人知，被认为是虚构的。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5836
Date 21 / 4 / 34

April 21, 1934.
Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

MOVEMENTS OF NOTABLES.

General Huang Fu, Chairman of the Peiping Political
Affairs Adjustment Committee, is leaving Shanghai to-day
for Hangchow to visit his ancestors' tomb. He will proceed
to Mokanshan and sojourn there for a few days.
The proposed meeting between General Huang and
Mr. Ariyoshi has been cancelled.
Wang Ching Wei will arrive here this morning.
It is learned that Mayor Wu Te Chen will proceed
to Soochow at 8 a.m. to-day by train. He will return to
Shanghai in the near future.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

T.V. SOONG ON CHINA'S CO-OPERATION WITH THE LEAGUE OF NATIONS.

Mr. T.V. Soong, Standing member of the National
Economic Commission, during a reception of local pressmen
at noon April 20 at the Shanghai Office of the Economic
Commission on Route Herve de Sieyes, French Concession,
made the following statement:-
"The Government intends to establish a finance
syndicate with Chinese capital with the object of re-
constructing China. The capital will be $10,000,000.
Japan has no right to interfere with technical co-operation
between China and the League of Nations."

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

REPRESENTATIVES OF DISABLED NORTH-EASTERN VOLUNTEERS GIVE
RECEPTION TO NEWSPAPERMEN.

At 3 p.m. yesterday Wong Tseng Jeu (王震球)
and others, representing the disabled officers and men
of the North-Eastern Volunteer Corps, gave a reception to
local newspapermen at the Kwan Sung Yuen Restaurant (冠生園),
Nanking Road. Some 40 reporters of various local papers
and new agencies attended.
During the function Wong Tseng Jeu made a report
on the accusation against General Chu Ching Lai who is
alleged to have retained the national salvation contributions.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

JAPANESE DESIRES TO ENLIST IN CHINESE ARMY.

A Japanese named S. Hisanaga, aged 27, has called
at the Shanghai City Government on three occasions and
demanded to interview Mayor Wu Te Chen. Questioned as to
the object of his visit, he said that he would like to
become a Chinese soldier because he disliked Japan. His
request was refused.
The Japanese was arrested by the Japanese Consular
Police and will be sent to Japan on April 22.

1934年4月21日。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

名人动向。

北平政务整理委员会委员长黄郛将军今日离开上海前往杭州祭扫祖坟。他将前往莫干山并在那里逗留数日。
原定的黄将军与有吉明先生的会晤已取消。
汪精卫将于今天上午抵达此地。
据悉，市长吴铁城将于今天上午8时乘火车前往苏州。他将在不久后返回上海。

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

宋子文谈中国与国联的合作。

全国经济委员会常务委员宋子文先生，于4月20日中午在法租界赫德路（Route Herve de Sieyes）经济委员会上海办事处接待本地记者时，发表了如下声明：
“政府打算建立一家拥有华资的金融辛迪加，旨在重建中国。资本为一千万美元。日本无权干涉中国与国联之间的技术合作。”

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

东北义勇军伤残代表招待记者。

昨日下午3时，王震球等人代表东北义勇军伤残官兵，在南京路冠生园酒楼招待本地记者。约40名本地各报社及通讯社记者出席。
活动期间，王震球就指控朱庆澜将军扣留救国捐款一事作了报告。

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

日本人希望加入中国军队。

一名名叫 S. Hisanaga（音译）、27岁的日本人曾三次前往上海市政府，要求会见市长吴铁城。当被问及来访目的时，他表示因厌恶日本而希望成为一名中国士兵。他的请求被拒绝。
该日本人已被日本领事警察逮捕，并将于4月22日被遣送回国。

page_data.en:
Translation of a letter received at Yulin Road Station
on April 20, 1934, purporting to emanate from the
"Shanghai Mass Meeting" and dated April 18, 1934.

------------------

April 18,

Police Brethren,

The traitor Huang Fu has arrived at
Shanghai with a view to contracting with the Japanese
Minister Ariyoshi a secret agreement, whereby all the
provinces in North China will be sold to Japan. The
North Eastern Armies have been compulsorily transferred
to the south. The joint postal and train services
mean the recognition of Manchukuo. We have decided
to convene a mass meeting, to surround Huang Fu and to
kill him. We are all Chinese. Though you are
in the service of the Police, you should on no account
listen to the instructions of the Imperialists and
massacre us. With our best regards,

Shanghai Mass Meeting.

警察同胞们，

上海，意图与日本公使

军队已被强制调往南方。
邮政和铁路联运
意味着承认“满洲国”。我们决定

受雇于警察部门，但绝不应
听从帝国主义的指令
屠杀我们。致以最良好的祝愿，

上海市民大会。

Association, dated April 18:

-----

(Chinese) Police and (Settlement) Police Brethren:

Now the garbage coolie Chiang Kai Shek of the
shameless Kuomintang Imperialists and his running
dog Huang Fu are going to give away our territory
to the north of the Yellow River to the Japanese Imperialists
and will also recognize Manchukuo as a permanent Japanese
colony. It will not be long before the joint train
and postal services materialize. We should unite all
revolutionary bodies of China and those brethren who
do not wish to become slaves in order to beat down
the traitorous Kuomintang and its running dog, Huang Fu.

Japanese movement and give a strong answer to the
Japanese imperialists and traitors.

如今，无耻的国民党帝国主义的垃圾苦力蒋介石及其走狗黄郛，正打算将黄河以北的我国领土割让给日本帝国主义，并将承认“满洲国”为日本的永久殖民地。不久之后，联运列车和邮政服务即将实现。我们应团结中国所有的革命团体以及那些不愿成为奴隶的兄弟们，以打倒叛国的国民党及其走狗黄郛。我们要发扬“一·二八”精神，扩大我们的抗日运动，对日本帝国主义者和汉奸给予有力的回击。

上海市中国学生联合会。4月18日。

The following is a letter addressed to Chinese Police Constables,
Yulin Road Station from the Shanghai Mass Meeting Association.

18th. April, 1934

Brothers,

Traitor Huang Foo has arrived Shanghai and he is
going to sign a secret treaty with Japanese Ambassador, Mr.
A. Ariyoshi to have the few provinces in the northern part
of China sold to Japan. The North-eastern Army are forced
to move southward now. The Postal Service and Railway Transac-
tion will be started to cooperate. They are going to recognize
Man-chu-kou. Now we are determined to hold a general mass
meeting to surround Huang Foo and to beat him to death. Although
you are working in the Police Station, but all of us are Chinese
Citizen. So, will you not to take any order from the imperialists
to slaughter us.
With heartly thanks.

Shanghai Mass Meeting Association.

衷心感谢。

上海市民大会。
